content:
Research the company like your offer depends on it. Because it does. 

Nothing kills momentum faster than "So... what does your company do?"

Before the interview, know:
→ What they actually sell and to whom
→ A recent piece of news or a milestone
→ Why you want to work there specifically

Generic candidates get generic outcomes. Specificity wins.
